hints.text: Sort integers primarily by their bit count in ascending order. Break ties by numerical value.

hints.text: Use sort key lambda x: (bin(x).count("1"), x).

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full parsing of numbers to binary strings is slower than built-in popcount.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hardware bit_count or popcount runs in O(1) time per number during sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies compound sorting key (popcount, value).
complexity.notes: bit_count() is native in Python 3.10+ and standard C++20 std::popcount.
